title: Research note (no κ): T74 #2322 words — owner fills capped at b < 0.001697195759 (#2374 within 8.1e-10); exact prices of handoffs, aliases and rank-1 climb merges
body:
**Research note (no κ claim).** For the [#2322](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2322) T74 words (base of the open #2349 / #2363 / #2374 line), this certifies the remaining owner-fill headroom and gives exact prices for local inventory moves.

| finding (LP-ceiling differences on the #2322 words, both providers, at a = #2374's κ) | value |
|---|---|
| **certified cap, any legal whole-helper owner fill of the #2322 words** | **b < 0.001697195759** |
| headroom above #2374's claim (0.0016971949509) | ≤ 8.1e-10 |
| one more #2322-type handoff (same reshapes) | +4.27e-8 each, linear up to 12 (+5.13e-7) |
| one #2339-type low alias | −1.91e-7 |
| one #2339-type high alias | exactly 0 |
| one (1,1)→(2) merge of two rank-1 climbs (no width change) | **+1.13e-7** |
| the 26 such target merges that come with #2339's low aliases, on their own | **+2.94e-6** |

**Why.** A climb of d dimensions pays one child of rank d, and total rank mass is fixed. So a move changes b only through the *shape* of the paid children, plus the helper widths acting through the width-aware bin patterns of #2387 / #2360.
- **Cap.** It comes from the #2387 LP with an exact rational dual and 800-bit enclosures (W·mu margin 1.85e-7, zero dual repair). The certificate does not reject #2374's claimed point. Owner relocations on these words therefore have at most 8.1e-10 left.
- **#2312 → #2322 decomposes exactly** into four handoffs:
  - remove (1,1,1,1) helpers 619/621/622/623;
  - X lenders 1/4/6/12 go (5,1,1,1)→(2,1,1,1,1,1,1);
  - partners 616/617/618/620 go (4,1,1,1,1)→(3,2,1,1,1).

  The LP predicts a +1.96e-7 ceiling gain; the realized claims gained +1.69e-7.
- **#2269 → #2339 decomposes exactly.**
  - A low alias's lender takes over the helper's climb, a net −h(3) locally, but the width change costs more through the bins.
  - A high alias is exactly neutral.
  - The 26 changed targets each gain exactly one (1,1)→(2) merge. These merges alone would be worth +2.94e-6, which dwarfs the owner-fill race.

**Leads (priced, not constructed).**
- 33 helpers still climb (1,1,1,1): the 32 #2226 low lenders plus 653.
- 12 X registers still climb (5,1,1,1) and lend no warp: 31 33 49 55 68 74 80 83 85 88 98 101.
- **Block 53** has exactly #2322's pre-handoff pattern: 653 next to four (4,1,1,1,1) partners 648/649/650/652. #2374 notes that alias 653 was dropped.

Whether any of these admits a legal coherent handoff is **not checked here**; it is listed under open next questions.

**Checks.**
- `move_prices.py` recounts which register pays each child in 8 pinned words. Each recount equals the word's reported profile and width inventory, and the decompositions add up exactly. Controls cover move signs, high-alias neutrality, the mass identity, and the certificate not rejecting #2374.
- `independent_recount.py` was written by a separate AI reviewer subagent from a plain statement of the frame rules, with its own GF(2) code and no shared code. It reproduces the profiles, the change set and the site lists for both providers.
- Package metadata (`--check-only`) passes; 65/65 research tests pass (2 skipped); 3.10 grammar check passes.
- Everything was run on CPython 3.14.4. The registered 3.12 replay was not run locally.

**Reproduce** (standard library only; `--fetch` pulls `refs/pull/{2312,2322,2269,2339}/head` if commits fb76f799 / 002304ef / b479fc55 / bf1742ae are absent; every word file is blob- and sha256-pinned):
```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-2322-move-prices/move_prices.py --fetch   # ~16 s -> PASS_T74_MOVE_PRICES cap=0.001697195759 handoff_db=+4.272e-08 low_alias_db=-1.906e-07 high_alias_net=0 sites=33/12
python3 -I -B research/t74-2322-move-prices/independent_recount.py   # -> PASS_T74_INDEPENDENT_RECOUNT
```
`vendor/pr2387/` holds pinned byte copies of #2387's `ceiling_lp.py` and `fill_check80.py` (this author). `move_prices.py` patches one line of `local_recount` at load time, to record the register that pays each child.

**Scope.** This is a pricing screen on fixed pinned words. Windows, families and ports are dropped, so prices are ceiling differences, not realized gains. The cap is a relaxation ceiling for unsplit helpers on the unchanged #2269 bin stock. No handoff or merge is constructed, and the selected frontier is untouched. Base: canonical main `0fdd7d82`. Task card: `complex-new-helper-inventory`, scope refined.
